name: boutiques
description: Plateforme SaaS de gestion de boutique pour commerçantes (monorepo). Toutes les commandes passent par npm.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix scripts install && npm --prefix apps/app_admin install && npm --prefix apps/app_boutique install
scripts.mobile:setup: cd apps/app_commercante && flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build
scripts.deploy: npm run db:push && npm run functions:secrets && npm run functions:deploy
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:functions && npm run test:admin && npm run test:boutique && npm run test:mobile
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/app_admin run lint && npm --prefix apps/app_admin run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/app_boutique run lint && npm --prefix apps/app_boutique run typecheck && cd apps/app_commercante && flutter analyze
